---
title: "Install"
---

dofjson needs Python 3.10 or newer.

```bash
pip install dofjson
```

## What it depends on

| Package | What it is for |
|---|---|
| `requests` | every request to SIDOF, to `www.dof.gob.mx` and to GitHub |
| `pypdf` | slicing a whole edition's PDF down to the pages of one legal provision |
| `platformdirs` | picking the per-user cache directory |

## The shipped certificate chain

`www.dof.gob.mx` serves its leaf certificate without the intermediate that
signs it, so verification fails with "unable to get local issuer certificate"
on any client that does not chase the issuer itself. The missing GoDaddy
intermediate, and its root, ship inside the package as
`dofjson/certs/dof-gob-mx-chain.pem`. The system trust store is tried first
and the bundled chain only on failure. Certificate verification is never
disabled.

## The cache directory

The `notas-archivo` assets that `download_dof_assets` writes, and that every
reader looks at first, live in `dofjson.titulos.CACHE_DIR`: an OS-appropriate
per-user directory, `~/.cache/dofjson` on Linux. It is the package's own and
is never shared with another package's. See [Titles](titles.qmd).

## Development install

```bash
pip install -e ".[test]"
pytest tests
```

No test touches the network: SIDOF, `www.dof.gob.mx` and GitHub are mocked.
